author: Greqkilib4
quote:
Tomb Raider came out in 1996, two years before Ocarina of Time, and already offered huge 3D environments, challenging puzzles, complex level design, and a genuine sense of exploration. Yet somehow, Ocarina of Time gets treated as if it single-handedly revolutionized gaming. Its reputation is massively inflated by nostalgia and Nintendo fanboyism.

The excessive hand-holding is another major issue. The game rarely trusts players to figure things out for themselves, making the entire experience feel restrictive and overly guided. There is very little sense of genuine freedom or accomplishment when the game practically tells you what to do at every step.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998)

author: Greqkilib4
quote: The art direction is horrible. It looks like Nintendo just stole some Unreal Engine 5 assets and threw them into their game. On top of that, the game doesn't even include Master Quest, which is absolutely **** game has also been completely dumbed down for casual players. The original was already designed for children, but this is even worse. It's an extremely linear, ridiculously easy game that constantly holds your hand and offers an absurd amount of assistance.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
